fitWindow.label: Fit the window by default
fitWindow.help: On, the image is scaled to the viewport; off, it is shown at 100%.

frameWindow.label: Match the window to the image
frameWindow.help: On, opening an image puts the window in the picture's shape, which the picture then fills edge to edge. Off, the window keeps the size it has.

settings.label: 默认适应窗口
settings.help: 开启后自动缩放到视口内；关闭后按 100% 原始尺寸显示。

settings.label: 窗口对齐图片
settings.help: 开启后打开图片时把窗口调成图片的形状，画面从边到边铺满、没有留白；关闭后窗口保持它自己的大小。
